language.entry: Error - no curio found!
Error - no curio found!
No negative quirks to remove.
The Spiv
Workn' hard I see, squire!
MERCHANT:What can I do for ya, squire.
He expects payment...
I ain't runnin' a charity mate!
A Spiteful Orphan
He seems to be waiting for something...
He is tapping his knife impatiently...
Careful, They be waiting for ya.
The Gift of Charity.
OI! Their Over Here!
The Tonic Seller
MERCHANT:If I may have your attention please!
He expects payment...
You all come back now, ya hear!
Interesting Recipe, let me see what I can do with it.
Sorry, fine folks, but no free samples!
Waste Bin
Well you know what they say...
Are you really going to stick your hand in there?
Well you got your hands dirty at least..
Who would throw away this?
Water Fountain
A old fountain, maybe it is safe?
Surely the water can't be that bad?
The pipes have rusted shut.
Something was in the water.
The seal purifies the water!
Abandoned Hot Dog Stand
Memories of a happier time.
Doubtful we will find anything useful here.
Vermin have long since had their feast.
You find some canned hot dogs.
The wretched smell nauseate the senses!
Illness fills your body!
The herbs eat away the mold!
Vending Machine
Merchant: A machine that dispenses items, if paid.
Exact Change Only.
No money no purchase.
You hear a item fallout after shacking the machine in anger.
The machine dispenses it's valuables!
Phone Booth
Not many where installed before the Retinue interfered.
Exact Change Only.
The wires have been cut.
You only hear heavy breathing.
"Just reminding where you need to go."
You manage to place a call to a loved one.
Lamp Post
They where once meant to signal a new age...
Maybe you can read the signs.
The signs have long since faded
The signs keep changing the more you try to understand.
You manage to locate where you are on your map.
Fortune Teller
A diversion once, now some take it's predictions seriously.
The machine stares at you expecting payment.
Nothing happened.
I suppose violence is one way of doing it.
It's revelations have left a deep impact on you!
The machine takes your burdens away from you.
Abandoned Newspaper Stand
You see old articles, magazines and comics.
Maybe something can be found.
All of it's contents have been eaten by time.
A article have left a impression on you.
You find a amusing comic.
You find a tourist map.
Broken Carriage
Looks like it was attacked recently.
Maybe something can be found.
You find nothing.
You find some useful items in the wreckage.
You scream at the horror you find.
